title: Man shot by RCMP in North Vancouver dies
article: A man shot by a North Vancouver RCMP officer on Saturday has died.
Vancouver Police say 39-year-old Matthew John Wilcox died in hospital Sunday evening, following surgery.
Vancouver Const. Lindsay Houghton says the B.C. Coroner's Service will conduct an autopsy to determine the cause of death.
Wilcox was shot Saturday afternoon in North Vancouver by a Mountie responding to a 911 call about a vehicle suspected in a crime.
RCMP say the man was hit in the torso after the police cruiser collided with a suspect vehicle and the driver of the car refused to comply with the lone officer's orders.
Vancouver Police are handling the investigation into the shooting.
